system.description:
Range: 30 spaces

You call upon the dead to do your bidding.

Once per turn, as a Free Action, you may choose the corpse of a creature within 30 spaces that is Size 1 or larger.

Until the start of your next turn, you may make any attacks and Actions as though you occupied that corpse's space, measuring Range, Area, and line of sight from it.

You do not move. You are still targeted, attacked, and affected where you actually are.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.
